ok I need to vent for a sec because what the actual hell.

Deb sent me a listing tonight from StickerBurrow Co for a “Knife Moth Vinyl Decal.” $6.50 or 3 for $15. its my switchblade moth. the one I drew for the sept 13 flash day and posted on my sheet august 30. I spent like 3 weekends at my kitchen table drawing that sheet and the moth was my favorite thing on it.

this isnt somebody drawing a moth with a knife and it happens to have the same vibe. its the same wing pattern, the same little crack in the blade, all of it. they didnt even flip it. its a straight scan of my linework being sold as a sticker and I never gave anybody permission to do that.

I messaged them and asked them to take it down. told them I had the original drawing and the post from august. their response was basically “love your work!” followed by moths are a common motif and if I have a registered copyright I can send it through their support form. have a great day!!

yes. moths are a common motif. the exact same moth with the exact same crack in the exact same blade is not a coincidence. come on.

and the part that really gets me is the person who got this tattoo messaged me tonight thinking I was the one selling stickers of it. I want them to know that I am NOT. I didnt sell your tattoo design to them or give them permission to use it. you paid for a one of one and I meant it.

for anybody who doesnt know how I do flash, each design is sold ONE time to ONE person. thats the whole deal. this one was picked in the first hour of flash day and it hasnt been tattooed on anybody else by me. someone chose that piece knowing it would be theirs, and now they have to see it slapped on a sticker listing. thats not fair to them either.

small shops and independent artists dont just have lawyer money sitting around to chase this stuff down every time somebody decides our work would look cute on a water bottle. and these sticker places know it. they can sell a bunch of somebody elses work for a few bucks at a time while the person who actually drew it has to spend their night trying to get it taken down.

if you have a minute, please report the “Knife Moth Vinyl Decal” listing from StickerBurrow Co. and please dont buy from them. I just want my work off their listing and the person wearing it to know I didnt do this.

anyway. gonna go be mad about this for a while. thank you Deb for sending it to me and thank you to everybody who looks out for artists. love yall.
